rules.summary: Authored files have at most 200 physical lines.
Authored files have at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes.
Ordinary authored lines have at most 120 Unicode scalars.
Tracked immediate directory entries have at most 16 members.
Tracked depth warns above 8 and fails above 12.
One-child directories require review.
Tracked symbolic links are forbidden.
Tracked paths must be classified regular UTF-8 files.
Conservatively detected packed Rust statements are forbidden.
Authored minified JSON is forbidden.
Giant encoded or hidden-source-like literals are forbidden.
Conservative Rust top-level item counts over 16 require review.
Conservative Rust import or module fanout over 16 requires review.
Generated and immutable provenance is exact, complete, and current.
Capsule allowed dependencies must be acyclic.
Capsules use the strict content-addressed capsule.json contract.
Capsule IDs and roots are unique and match manifest locations.
Actual internal Cargo dependencies are allowed by their capsule.
Allowed and forbidden capsule dependencies resolve without overlap.
Capsule dependency and principal concept fanout is at most 16.
Capsule facade, test, and decision evidence resolves exactly.
Audit reads remain within fixed input bounds.
Repository revision and file sizes remain stable during audit.
Tooling module names describe their exact responsibility.
